ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green crisp lettuce leaves with ruffled edges, torn into pieces about 3-6 cm, light sheen from dressing, spread across upper-left of plate covering roughly 20% of plate area, low-medium height | 45
ITEM 2 | Dark green wilted-looking spinach/leafy greens with thin veins, glossy and slightly moist, some pale stems, covering about 15% of plate in upper-right, moderate height | 35
ITEM 3 | Shredded orange carrot strands, thin matchsticks about 3-5 cm long, bright orange, scattered among the greens | 5
ITEM 4 | Small piece of cherry tomato, red skin with pale interior, about 2 cm across, partly hidden under greens | 6
ITEM 5 | Pale green-white cucumber or similar sliced piece, round slices about 2 cm diameter, semi-translucent, mostly under leafy greens | 4
ITEM 6 | Yellow corn cob cross-section, two rounds about 4 cm diameter and 3 cm thick, bright yellow kernels with cut-open pale centers, slightly moist, holds shape, next to a small piece of corn cut from the cob | 60
ITEM 7 | Flat triangular slice of baked flatbread-style crust, golden-brown with darker charred edges, covered with red tomato sauce and light cheese-like topping, about 10 x 6 cm, slightly crisp, sits at lower-left of plate | 70
ITEM 8 | Cooked poultry drumstick, smooth golden-tan skin with light browning, rounded shape about 10 cm long and 4-5 cm thick, moist-looking, lower-center of plate | 85
ITEM 9 | Small amount of yellowish dressing, creamy and semi-glossy, dabbed on lettuce and plate edge near corn, thin smear about 3 cm | 8
